name: teenage engineering
oneLine: Swedish hardware maker's storefront; black, monochrome, hairline-light type and pictogram nav like a product manual.

palette.note: Page body and the band beneath the hero photo
Nav labels, 'NOW OPEN!' block, footer links
Near-black brick of the full-bleed B&W storefront photo
Glowing neon sign text in the photo, the only highlight on the page

type.note: 26px weight 100 hairline for nav headings ('products', 'store'), all lowercase, tight tracking
~19px weight 100 for footer links and announcements; announcements set in uppercase
9px weight 100-300 for nav sub-links and a Japanese mission paragraph, lowercase, stacked 3 lines
Single 300-weight use; wider sibling cut kept for special marks

layout: Header is a six-column strip at 66px side margins: each column pairs a ~80px outlined SVG pictogram with a 26px heading and three 9px sub-links; the TE logo sits far right.
Body is a single full-bleed B&W photograph (~1200px tall) with the nav overlaid on it, then ~120px of black and a centered two-line announcement.
Footer is one baseline row: region select left, seven links centered, copyright right, all 19px hairline.
motion: Very little visible motion; the page relies on stillness and photography.
(inferred) Line pictograms in the nav (flower, box, magnifier/gear) animate or redraw on hover; 17 inline SVGs support this.
(inferred) Mobile menu (three-dot button, cart counter tile) slides open as a full-screen sheet.
interactions: Pictogram-plus-label mega nav: each column is a hover target revealing its three sub-links.
Mobile collapses to a cart counter tile (light grey '0') top-left and a vertical three-dot menu top-right.
steal: Pictogram nav columns: one hairline SVG glyph per section (dataset, model, results, demo) in the header of our telemetry site.
Hairline weight-100 lowercase headings at ~26px over pure black for the page chrome, keeping the data visuals the brightest thing on screen.
Single full-bleed monochrome hero image (a satellite or ground-station photo) with nav overlaid, then a stark black band with a centered two-line status line ('MISSION ACTIVE / 58 CHANNELS').
leave: 9px weight-100 sub-labels: near-illegible on non-retina screens and fails contrast for dense technical copy.
Almost zero content on the home page: fine for a brand store, but our page must surface results and methodology immediately.
